**Security Misconfiguration**

**Reachability:** Internal  
**Exploitability:** Difficult  
**CWE:** [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html) — Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere

**Pin `membrowse` at every CI install site.**

The wheel-only option blocks sdist setup scripts. It does not restrict code that the installed wheel executes. Upload steps run Membrowse with `MEMBROWSE_API_KEY` available. A compromised release could therefore access the key.

`tools/code_size.py` also contains compatibility handling for Membrowse 1.2.9. Version differences are recorded only as “comparable, not exact” notes, while the comparison still computes size deltas. Use one pinned version for reproducible results.
